llms.body:
# Fingerprint

> Fingerprint is a device intelligence and fraud prevention platform that identifies web and mobile visitors with industry-leading accuracy — even anonymous ones. It assigns a persistent visitor ID to browsers and devices using 100+ signals, and provides real-time risk signals (Smart Signals) to help fraud teams stop bad actors without friction for good users.

Fingerprint was founded by Dan Pinto and Valentin Vasilyev. It evolved from the open-source FingerprintJS project (2012) and is now a commercial SaaS platform headquartered in Chicago, IL with a remote-first global team. It is trusted by 6,000+ companies and has identified over 7 billion unique browsers and devices annually.

Fingerprint does NOT collect personal data (names, emails, passwords), does NOT identify individual people, does NOT sell or share user data with third parties, and does NOT replace authentication, KYC, or payment systems. It complements them.

## Get started and installation

- [Fingerprint CLI](https://github.com/fingerprintjs/fingerprint-cli): Recommended way to install Fingerprint. Run `npx fingerprint` in your codebase to use the CLI. Detects your application's framework, configures your workspace and API keys, and adds the integration to your codebase.
- [Agent install guide](https://fingerprint.com/get-started.md): Step-by-step instructions for coding agents adding Fingerprint to an app with the CLI
- [Agent skills](https://fingerprint.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Fingerprint skills for coding agents. Install with `npx skills add fingerprintjs/skills`
- [MCP server](https://docs.fingerprint.com/docs/mcp-server): Query Fingerprint events, Smart Signals, and manage API keys from an AI agent
- [Authentication for agents](https://fingerprint.com/auth.md): How AI agents and automated clients authenticate to Fingerprint APIs
- [Documentation](https://docs.fingerprint.com): Installation guides, framework quickstarts, configuration options, and API references

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://fingerprint.com/): Platform overview, accuracy demo, customer stats
- [AI Info Page](https://fingerprint.com/blog/ai-info-page/): Official structured information about Fingerprint for AI assistants and LLMs
- [Pricing](https://fingerprint.com/pricing/): Plans and pricing
- [Demo](https://fingerprint.com/demo/): Live visitor identification demo
- [Documentation](https://docs.fingerprint.com): Full technical documentation
- [Integrations](https://fingerprint.com/integrations/): Supported third-party integrations
- [SDKs and Libraries](https://fingerprint.com/sdk-libraries/): JavaScript, iOS, Android, React, Next.js, Angular, Vue, Flutter, and more
- [About Us](https://fingerprint.com/about-us/): Company background and team
- [Careers](https://fingerprint.com/careers/): Open roles
- [Security](https://fingerprint.com/security/): Security practices and compliance (GDPR, CCPA, SOC 2, ISO 27001)
- [System Status](https://status.fingerprint.com): Uptime and incident history
- [FAQ](https://fingerprint.com/resources/frequently-asked-questions-faqs/): Frequently asked questions

## Blogs

- [Browser Fingerprinting Techniques](https://fingerprint.com/blog/browser-fingerprinting-techniques/): Overview of the techniques used to fingerprint browsers and identify visitors
- [VPN Detection: How It Works](https://fingerprint.com/blog/vpn-detection-how-it-works/): How Fingerprint detects VPN usage and why it matters for fraud prevention
- [Audio Fingerprinting](https://fingerprint.com/blog/audio-fingerprinting/): How audio context is used as a fingerprinting signal
- [Canvas Fingerprinting](https://fingerprint.com/blog/canvas-fingerprinting/): How HTML5 canvas rendering differences are used to identify browsers
- [What Is Browser Spoofing?](https://fingerprint.com/blog/what-is-browser-spoofing/): How fraudsters spoof browser attributes and how to detect it
- [Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) Fraud](https://fingerprint.com/blog/buy-now-pay-later-bnpl/): Fraud risks specific to BNPL platforms and how device intelligence helps
- [Limitations of JA3 Fingerprinting](https://fingerprint.com/blog/limitations-ja3-fingerprinting-accurate-device-identification/): Why JA3 TLS fingerprinting alone is insufficient for accurate device identification
- [Browser Fingerprinting with PHP](https://fingerprint.com/blog/browser-fingerprint-php/): How to implement browser fingerprinting server-side using PHP
- [Bot Detection](https://fingerprint.com/blog/bot-detection/): How bot detection works and the signals used to identify automated traffic
- [Location Spoofing Detection](https://fingerprint.com/blog/location-spoofing-detection/): How to detect when users are faking their location using VPNs, proxies, or GPS spoofing


## Products

- [Device Intelligence Platform](https://fingerprint.com/products/fingerprint-pro/): Core identification product — persistent visitor ID across sessions, browsers, and devices
- [Smart Signals](https://fingerprint.com/products/smart-signals/): 20+ real-time risk signals including bot detection, VPN detection, browser tampering, incognito mode, jailbreak detection, and more
- [Bot Detection](https://fingerprint.com/products/bot-detection/): Detects malicious bots, headless browsers, and automation tools
- [Identification](https://fingerprint.com/products/identification/): Persistent visitor identification that survives cookie clearing, IP changes, and private browsing
- [AI Agent Detection](https://fingerprint.com/products/ai-agent-detection/): Detect AI agents and automated traffic on your platform

## Use cases

- [Account Takeover Prevention](https://fingerprint.com/use-cases/account-takeover/): Block login attempts using stolen credentials while recognizing legitimate users
- [Payment Fraud Prevention](https://fingerprint.com/use-cases/payment-fraud/): Reduce fraudulent transactions and increase legitimate conversions
- [New Account Fraud](https://fingerprint.com/use-cases/new-account-fraud-prevention/): Stop repeat signups, trial abuse, and fake account creation
- [SMS Fraud](https://fingerprint.com/use-cases/sms-fraud/): Prevent SMS pumping fraud and SIM swapping scams
- [Bot Detection](https://fingerprint.com/products/bot-detection/): Prevent sophisticated automated attacks in real time
- [Paywall Enforcement](https://fingerprint.com/use-cases/paywall/): Eliminate paywall bypass techniques
- [Device Authentication](https://fingerprint.com/use-cases/device-authentication/): Recognize trusted devices for faster logins and fewer step-up challenges
- [Account Sharing Prevention](https://fingerprint.com/use-cases/account-sharing-prevention/): Detect and monetize shared accounts

## Industries

- [Fintech](https://fingerprint.com/industries/fintech/)
- [E-commerce](https://fingerprint.com/industries/e-commerce/)
- [Buy Now Pay Later](https://fingerprint.com/industries/buy-now-pay-later/)
- [iGaming](https://fingerprint.com/industries/igaming/)
- [Travel](https://fingerprint.com/industries/travel/)
- [Cryptocurrency](https://fingerprint.com/industries/cryptocurrency/)
- [Banking](https://fingerprint.com/industries/banking/)

## Resources

- [Blog](https://fingerprint.com/blog/): Articles on fraud prevention, device intelligence, and AEO
- [Case Studies](https://fingerprint.com/case-studies/): Customer stories including Booking.com, Chegg, and others
- [Guides](https://fingerprint.com/blog/tag/guides/): In-depth technical and strategic guides
- [Tutorials](https://fingerprint.com/blog/tag/tutorials/): Developer tutorials
- [Resource Center](https://fingerprint.com/resources/): Whitepapers, reports, and more
- [Press](https://fingerprint.com/resources/press/): News and media coverage
- [Partners](https://fingerprint.com/partners/): Partner ecosystem

## Community & support

- [Discord Community](https://discord.gg/ad6R2ttHVX)
- [GitHub (open-source FingerprintJS)](https://github.com/fingerprintjs/fingerprintjs/) — 27k+ stars
- [Reddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/fingerprintjs/)
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/fingerprintjs/)
- [Support Center](https://fingerprint.com/support/)
